_reviewProvenance: PROMOTE on the second run of this gate against this cut. Run 1 (6465ef53) returned HOLD on one finding: docs/how-to/install.md enumerated four lint gates while this cut's own site-render prerequisite made preflight five — the same defect v0.6.4 corrected (three to four) and this release re-introduced one cut later. The install guide, CONTRIBUTING.md and the Makefile .PHONY list are corrected, and the recurrence is captured as iss-2608242043243131 with both instances as the detector's acceptance corpus. This run diffed HEAD against run 1's tree and found exactly four changed files — the new issue record, CONTRIBUTING.md, the Makefile .PHONY line and the install guide — so no surface run 1 cleared could have regressed, and the rename and site-render entries were not re-litigated. Claims were exercised rather than read: `make site-render` ran green and left no directory, confirming the changelog's 'throwaway directory and keeps nothing'; .githooks/pre-push invokes preflight, confirming the pre-push coupling; ci.yml's Site-render gate is guarded only on the Linux matrix leg with no inert condition, confirming 'never stood down'; the prebuilt binary's help tree matches the generated CLI reference and its drift test passes. The rename's restraint claim was checked exhaustively: a tracked-file grep for the old organisation returns only the CHANGELOG's earlier-transfer entry and historical records under .abcd/. Run 1 also verified the release notes' strongest assertion against .github/workflows/site.yml directly — resolve peels the tag to an immutable sha, render checks out that sha and downloads the binary from that release, and push:[main] reaches only the non-production preview — so a content defect in a released tree does wait for the next release, which is why this cut exists. Not covered: the network install one-liners and a real marketplace add, the race lane, the smoke harness, the Playwright mobile audit, CHANGELOG sections below 0.6.4, and the sources corpus outside this repository. The judge is the release session's pinned harness model.
